metadata.description: Compliance: build it compliant instead of finding the gaps in due diligence. A stdlib scanner for code and running apps, mapped to SOC 2, ISO 27001, OWASP, PCI DSS, GDPR, LGPD, CCPA, the EU AI Act and more, with hooks that re-check every edit.

plugins.name: compliance
plugins.description: Scans what Claude builds for compliance gaps and maps each finding to the frameworks it breaks. Hooks check every edit and re-scan the project when a turn ends: new critical or high issues make Claude fix them or tell you, and everything still open stays in front of you as a one-line warning. Invoke with /Compliance, or just build something.
